page_title: TOR 2-0 LEC | Torino v Lecce 16/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Giovanni Ayroldi is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' David Okereke (Torino) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90+3' The Torino players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
90+2' Torino score a goal, but referee Giovanni Ayroldi has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A substitution has been made. Ivan Ilic goes off and Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) comes on.
88' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with David Okereke (Torino) replacing Duvan Zapata.

86' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic leaps like a salmon to deny Antonino Gallo (Lecce), whose effort is headed to the top left corner of the goal, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.
85' Ahmed Touba (Lecce) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.

81' 2 - 0 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Duvan Zapata (Torino), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go into the bottom right corner. The score changes to 2:0.
80' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Torino.
79' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Roberto Piccoli is replaced by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce).
79' Here comes a substitution. Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is brought on as a substitute for Patrick Dorgu.
79' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
78' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) gets booked for the first time in this match.
78' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' A cross by Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
76' Here comes a substitution. Valentino Lazaro is given a rest as he is replaced by Mergim Vojvoda (Torino).
74' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a change. Ahmed Touba (Lecce) replaces Remi Oudin.
70' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle and Marin Pongracic (Lecce) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
68' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
66' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) bursts into the box and latches on to a pin-point long through ball, but one of the defenders steps in to clear the ball to safety.
66' Karol Linetty (Torino) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for an infringement.
64' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
62' Substitution. Nikola Vlasic makes way for Karol Linetty (Torino).
62' The substitution has been made. Antonio Sanabria (Torino) has replaced Pietro Pellegri.
62' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Alexis Blin will be replaced by Mohamed Kaba (Lecce).
61' Hamza Rafia goes off the pitch and Nicola Sansone (Lecce) comes on.
61' Remi Oudin (Lecce) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
60' Adam Masina (Torino) trips an opposition player and Giovanni Ayroldi signals a foul. A free kick is awarded to Lecce.
58' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) with a great individual effort and attempt from long range. The shot went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was prepared and managed to keep the ball out.
55' Adam Masina (Torino) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Giovanni Ayroldi stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
53' A cross from a corner kick by Torino is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

52' Duvan Zapata (Torino) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Torino.
50' The foul by Alexis Blin (Lecce) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Giovanni Ayroldi.
50' 1 - 0 Goal! Ivan Ilic plays a short, square pass into the path of Raoul Bellanova (Torino), who bends a shot straight into the bottom left corner to make it 1:0. Fabulous goal!
49' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Giovanni Ayroldi saw the whole situation.
48' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
47' Duvan Zapata (Torino) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' Giovanni Ayroldi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' Remi Oudin (Lecce) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
45' Koffi Djidji (Torino) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Giovanni Ayroldi didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
43' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
43' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
41' A yellow card for a tackle by Marin Pongracic (Lecce). Giovanni Ayroldi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
41' Giovanni Ayroldi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Duvan Zapata (Torino).
39' The resulting corner, taken by Valentino Lazaro (Torino), comes to nothing.

39' Duvan Zapata (Torino) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant. The ball goes out of play. Torino are awarded a corner kick.
37' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Giovanni Ayroldi blows for a foul.
36' Duvan Zapata (Torino) plays a through ball but overhits it.
34' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) picks up a long through ball, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
31' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) picks up an injury.
29' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
28' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
24' Samuele Ricci (Torino) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
22' Remi Oudin (Lecce) will deliver the corner kick.
22' Dangerous play by Adam Masina (Torino). Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
19' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
18' The Torino players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
15' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) jumps into a tackle and Giovanni Ayroldi signals a foul.
14' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper.
14' Remi Oudin (Lecce) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
13' Remi Oudin (Lecce) sends the corner into the box, but Vanja Milinkovic-Savic intercepts it and averts the threat.
12' Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
11' The referee awards a corner and Ivan Ilic (Torino) goes over to take it.
11' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pietro Pellegri (Torino). It will be a corner kick for Torino.
11' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
10' A quickly taken corner by Lecce.
9' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
9' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul after Ivan Ilic (Torino) hacks down one of his opponents.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

6' The game is interrupted. Marin Pongracic (Lecce) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Torino have been awarded a free kick.
3' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Lecce will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Giovanni Ayroldi.
